name: Ha Long resort living
summary: Overnight boats and Bai Chay harbor hotels when the karst bay is the stay, not a Hanoi day trip.
body: A resort stay here is often the cabin on the water. Bai Chay city hotels suit an early pier start.
Vinpearl on Reu Island and Wyndham Legend Halong are on their operator sites but lack a distinct licensed photo here, so they are not named below.

properties.name: Paradise Elegance
properties.summary: Overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay with balcony cabins, departing Tuan Chau Marina.
